name: HBO Max

fastest.text: Go to hbomax.com/subscription in a browser, sign in and select Cancel Your Subscription.

steps: Go to hbomax.com/subscription in a web browser and sign in.
Check who bills you; it's shown at the top of the screen.
If HBO Max bills you directly, select Cancel Your Subscription.
Confirm, and note the expiration date it shows.
note: Billed by Amazon, Google Play, Roku, Samsung or your internet, mobile or TV provider? Cancel with them; the HBO Max site won't show a cancel option.

faq.q: Do I keep watching after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes. You can stream until your subscription expires at the end of the billing period.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel HBO Max?
faq.a: No. Deleting the app doesn't cancel your subscription.

faq.q: Why don't I see a cancel option?
faq.a: Usually because someone else bills you, such as Apple, Amazon, Roku or your internet or TV provider. The billing party is listed at the top of hbomax.com/subscription.
Basic with ads is the cheapest HBO Max plan in the US, at $10.99/mo.
